source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 10 (PDF 229-250), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Electromagnetism) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Explain why a current-carrying conductor placed in a uniform magnetic field experiences a force and how its direction is found. Obtain the expression F = BIL sin θ and write it in vector form. Hence define magnetic induction and its SI unit. (5 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke uniform magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force kyun lagti hai aur us ki simt kaise maloom hoti hai. F = BIL sin θ ka formula hasil karein aur vector shakal mein likhein. Is se magnetic induction aur us ki SI unit ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Force ki wajah: Seedha conductor steady current (kaghaz se bahar) le kar uniform magnetic field par amoodi rakha hai (Fig. 10.2). Us ka apna magnetic field bahar ke field se asar karta hai, jaise do magnets aik doosre par. Dono fields conductor ki aik taraf mil kar taaqatwar aur doosri taraf aik doosre ko kaat dete hain, is liye conductor kamzor field wali taraf jata hai. Force F conductor aur field dono par amoodi hai.

Simt: Fleming ka left-hand rule (Fig. 10.3): pehli ungli magnetic field ki taraf, doosri ungli current ki taraf; angootha force batata hai. Ya daayen haath ki ungliyan chhote angle se current se field ki taraf morein; seedha angootha force batata hai.

Magnitude: Tajrube se force current I, lambai L aur field B ke seedhe tanasub mein hai:
F ∝ BIL, is liye F = kBIL
SI units mein k = 1, lehaza
F = BIL ... (10.1)
Agar conductor B se θ angle banaye to sirf B par amoodi component L sin θ kaam karta hai (Fig. 10.4):
F = BIL sin θ ... (10.2)
Vector L (magnitude lambai ke barabar, simt current ki taraf) le kar vector shakal:
F = I L × B ... (10.3)
θ = 90° par force sab se zyada (BIL) aur θ = 0 par sifar hai.

Magnetic induction: Eq. (10.1) se B = F/IL. Magnetic field strength (magnetic induction) adadi tor par us force ke barabar hai jo field par amoodi, 1 A current wale 1 m lambe conductor par lagti hai. Yeh field ki simt mein vector hai. SI unit: tesla, 1 T = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Let us now determine the magnitude of the force on a current-carrying conductor

blocks.prompt:
2 A 35 cm wire carrying 5.0 A lies in a uniform magnetic field of 0.20 T. Find (i) the force on it when it makes 50° with the field (ii) the maximum force it can experience (iii) the angle at which the force is 0.20 N. (3 marks)
(5.0 A current wali 35 cm taar 0.20 T ke uniform magnetic field mein hai. Nikalein: (i) field se 50° par us par force (ii) sab se zyada force jo us par lag sakti hai (iii) woh angle jis par force 0.20 N ho.)
blocks.explanation: F = BIL sin θ lagayein; sab se zyada θ = 90° par; (iii) mein sin θ = F/BIL hal karein.

book_ref.quote: If the wire makes an angle of 40° with the direction of magnetic field

steps: Diya gaya: L = 0.35 m, I = 5.0 A, B = 0.20 T

blocks.prompt:
3 Define magnetic flux and obtain ϕ_B = BA cos θ = B · A. Discuss the cases of maximum and zero flux, explain how the flux through a curved surface is found, and show why B is called magnetic flux density. Give the units of flux and flux density. (5 marks)
(Magnetic flux ki definition likhein aur ϕ_B = BA cos θ = B · A hasil karein. Sab se zyada aur sifar flux ki suraten, curved surface ka flux nikalne ka tareeqa, aur B ko magnetic flux density kehne ki wajah bayan karein. Flux aur flux density ki units likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Kisi area A se guzarne wali magnetic lines ki tadaad us area se magnetic flux hai.

Derivation: Agar B field par amoodi unit area se guzarne wali lines ki tadaad ho to field par amoodi area A ke liye
B = ϕ/A ... (10.4), yani ϕ = BA
Agar surface ka normal B se θ angle banaye (Fig. 10.5) to vector area ki simt mein B ka component B cos θ hai (Fig. 10.6):
ϕ_B = BA cos θ ... (10.5)
Chunke B aur A vectors hain,
ϕ_B = B · A ... (10.6)
is liye flux scalar hai. A ki magnitude area aur simt surface ke normal ki taraf hai; θ, B aur A ka angle hai.

Khaas suraten (Fig. 10.7): (a) Field normal ki seedh mein: θ = 0, cos 0° = 1, flux sab se zyada = BA. (b) Field area ke plane ke mutawazi: θ = 90°, cos 90° = 0, flux sifar.

Curved surface: Isay bohat se chhote plane elements mein baantein, har aik ka BA cos θ nikal kar sab jama karein.

Units aur flux density: Tesla se flux ki unit N m A⁻¹ hai jise weber (Wb) kehte hain. Eq. (10.4) ke mutabiq B, B par amoodi surface ka fi unit area flux hai, is liye isay magnetic flux density bhi kehte hain; unit Wb m⁻² = N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ (tesla).

book_ref.quote: We can represent the strength of a magnetic field B by the lines of force

blocks.prompt:
4 A rectangular loop 40 cm × 25 cm is placed in a uniform magnetic field of 0.90 T. Find the magnetic flux through it when the angle between B and the vector area is (i) 0° (ii) 40° (iii) 90°. (3 marks)
(40 cm × 25 cm ka rectangular loop 0.90 T ke uniform magnetic field mein hai. B aur vector area ka angle (i) 0° (ii) 40° (iii) 90° ho to loop se magnetic flux nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Area m² mein nikalein, phir har angle ke liye ϕ = BA cos θ lagayein.

book_ref.quote: A rectangular loop of wire is placed in a uniform magnetic field of magnitude 1.2 T

blocks.prompt:
5 What is magnetic flux linkage? Write its equation and explain the meaning of each symbol. Describe its importance in electrical devices and in Faraday's law, and give one everyday application of magnetism mentioned in this section. (5 marks)
(Magnetic flux linkage kya hai? Is ki equation likh kar har symbol ka matlab batayein. Electrical devices aur Faraday ke qanoon mein is ki ahmiyat bayan karein, aur is section mein di gayi magnetism ki aik rozmarra application likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Magnetic flux linkage coil se guzarne wale magnetic flux aur coil ke turns ki tadaad ka hasil-e-zarb hai. Yeh batata hai ke kayi turns ki wajah se coil ke saath kitna flux jura hai.

Equation:
Magnetic flux linkage = Φ = Nϕ_B ... (10.7)
jahan ϕ_B = BA cos θ, A area ke aik loop se flux hai aur N coil ke kul turns hain. Unit: weber (Wb).

Ahmiyat: Flux linkage samajhne mein madad deti hai ke coils aur inductors circuits mein kaise kaam karte hain. Transformers, electric motors, generators aur inductors ke design aur kaam mein is ka aham kirdar hai.

Faraday ke qanoon mein: Coil ki induced emf flux linkage ki tabdeeli ki sharah par munhasir hai, ε = -N Δϕ/Δt; N turns wali coil aik loop se N guna emf deti hai.

Application: ATM ya credit card ki magnetic strip mein lakhon chhote magnetic domains resin binder se jure hote hain; machine strip par likhi maloomat parhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Magnetic flux linkage refers to the product of the magnetic flux through a coil

blocks.prompt:
6 A coil of 120 turns, each of area 0.015 m², is placed in a uniform field of 0.40 T with the normal to the coil at 30° to the field. Find (i) the flux through one turn (ii) the flux linkage (iii) the flux linkage when the coil is turned so that its normal is along the field. (3 marks)
(120 turns wali coil, har turn ka area 0.015 m², 0.40 T ke uniform field mein hai aur coil ka normal field se 30° par hai. Nikalein: (i) aik turn se flux (ii) flux linkage (iii) flux linkage jab coil ghuma kar us ka normal field ki seedh mein kar diya jaye.)
blocks.explanation: Aik turn ka ϕ_B = BA cos θ nikal kar N se zarb dein; (iii) mein θ = 0 lein.

book_ref.quote: Magnetic flux linkage plays a crucial role in the design and operation of transformers

blocks.prompt:
7 Starting from the force on a current-carrying conductor, derive the force F = q v × B on a charged particle moving in a uniform magnetic field. When is it maximum and when zero? Show that a particle entering the field at right angles moves in a circle of radius r = mv/qB. (5 marks)
(Current wale conductor par force se shuru kar ke uniform magnetic field mein chalte charged particle par force F = q v × B derive karein. Yeh kab sab se zyada aur kab sifar hoti hai? Sabit karein ke field mein amoodan daakhil particle r = mv/qB radius ke daire mein chalta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Chalte charges ka current: N particles, har aik ka charge q, t waqt mein L lambai ke conductor se guzarte hain. Current
I = Q/t = Nq/t
Agar un ki velocity v ho to v = v L̂, jahan L̂ current (positive charges ki harkat) ki simt mein unit vector hai. Woh L lambai t = L/v waqt mein tay karte hain, is liye
I = Nq/t = Nqv/L ... (10.8)

Force: Uniform field B mein conductor par
F = I L × B ... (10.9), aur L = L L̂ ... (10.10)
I aur L rakhne se:
F = (Nqv/L)(L L̂ × B)
F = Nqv L̂ × B ... (10.11)
Chunke v, L̂ ki seedh mein hai, v L̂ = v:
F = Nq v × B ... (10.12)
Lehaza aik particle par force
F = q v × B ... (10.13)
Magnitude, θ = v aur B ka angle:
F = qvB sin θ ... (10.14)
v, B par amoodi ho (θ = 90°) to sab se zyada aur v, B ki seedh mein ho (θ = 0) to sifar. Force ka nishan q ke nishan par munhasir hai: positive aur negative charge ulti simton mein murte hain (Fig. 10.10). Simt Fleming ke left-hand rule ya right hand rule se milti hai.

Daira: Jab v, B par amoodi ho to F = qvB. Yeh force hamesha v par amoodi hai, is liye centripetal force deti hai:
qvB = mv²/r
r = mv/qB

book_ref.quote: We can calculate this force by examining the behaviour of a current-carrying conductor

blocks.prompt:
8 An electron (m = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) moves at 3.0 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ in a uniform magnetic field of 0.20 T. Find (i) the force on it when its velocity makes 60° with the field (ii) the radius of its path when it moves at right angles to the field. (3 marks)
(Electron (m = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) 0.20 T ke uniform magnetic field mein 3.0 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. Nikalein: (i) us par force jab velocity field se 60° par ho (ii) us ke raaste ka radius jab woh field par amoodi chale.)
blocks.explanation: Force ke liye F = qvB sin θ; daire ke liye magnetic force hi centripetal force hai, is liye r = mv/eB.

book_ref.quote: An election enters into a uniform magnetic field perpendicularly

blocks.prompt:
9 What is a velocity selector? Describe its construction and working, and show that the selected speed is v = E/B. Also show how the charge to mass ratio of the particle can be found by switching off the electric field. (5 marks)
(Velocity selector kya hai? Is ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein aur sabit karein ke chuni hui speed v = E/B hai. Yeh bhi dikhayein ke electric field band kar ke particle ka charge to mass ratio kaise nikala jata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Velocity selector charged particle ki velocity maloom karne ka aala hai. Chalte particle par electric aur magnetic forces aise lagti hain ke sirf aik velocity par barabar hon.

Banawat: Magnetic field B mein aik cylindrical tube hai. Tube ke andar parallel plate capacitor hai jo B par amoodi uniform electric field E banata hai (Fig. 10.12).

Kaam: +q charge wala particle B par amoodi velocity v se baayen sire se daakhil hota hai. Us par magnetic force oopar (Fig. 10.11) aur electric force neeche, E ki simt mein lagti hai. E aur B munasib hon to dono forces aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain. Net force sifar, is liye velocity mustaqil (Newton ka pehla qanoon); particle seedhi line mein chal kar daayen sire se nikalta hai. Doosri velocities wale particles mur jaate hain aur daayen sire se nahi nikalte.

Chuni hui speed: Chunke v, B aur E dono par amoodi hai,
Magnetic force (oopar) = Bqv
Electric force (neeche) = qE
Na murne ke liye: Bqv = qE
v = E/B ... (10.15)

Charge to mass ratio: E band karne par sirf magnetic force reh jati hai jo centripetal force deti hai, aur particle r radius ke daire mein chalta hai:
Bqv = mv²/r, is liye q/m = v/Br
v = E/B rakhne se:
q/m = E/B²r

book_ref.quote: A velocity selector consists of a cylindrical tube located within a magnetic field B.

blocks.prompt:
10 Charged particles pass undeflected through a velocity selector with E = 4.5 × 10³ N C⁻¹ and B = 0.15 T. When the electric field is switched off they move in a circle of radius 2.0 cm. Find (i) their speed (ii) their charge to mass ratio. (3 marks)
(Charged particles E = 4.5 × 10³ N C⁻¹ aur B = 0.15 T wale velocity selector se bina mure guzarte hain. Electric field band karne par woh 2.0 cm radius ke daire mein chalte hain. Nikalein: (i) un ki speed (ii) un ka charge to mass ratio.)
blocks.explanation: Speed ke liye qE = Bqv; E band ho to Bqv = mv²/r se q/m = E/B²r.

book_ref.quote: When the electric filed is turned OFF, the charged particle travels on a circular path

blocks.prompt:
11 What is motional emf? Describe the rod-and-rails experiment and derive the expression ε = -vBL for the motional emf. How is it modified when v makes an angle θ with B, and why does the current keep flowing? (5 marks)
(Motional emf kya hai? Rod aur rails wala tajruba bayan karein aur motional emf ka formula ε = -vBL derive karein. Jab v, B se θ angle banaye to formula kaise badalta hai, aur current kyun behta rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Magnetic field ke aar paar conductor ki harkat se paida emf motional emf kehlati hai. Yeh battery ki tarah hai: sire jor kar band circuit banane par current behta hai.

Tajruba (Fig. 10.13): L lambai ki conducting rod L faasle wali do mutawazi metal rails par hai; siron c aur d ke darmiyan galvanometer laga hai aur loop abcda banta hai. Uniform field B kaghaz ke andar hai. Rod ruki ho to current nahi; rod ko mustaqil velocity v se daayen kheenchne par current behta hai. Chalti rod emf ka source hai: ε = Vb - Va = ΔV.

Derivation: Rod mein charge q velocity v se B mein chalta hai aur us par F = q v × B lagti hai, magnitude F = qvB sin θ. Chunke θ = 90°,
F = qvB ... (10.16)
Right hand rule se yeh force a se b ki taraf hai, is liye charges oopari sire b par jama hote hain aur a par kami hoti hai. Is se b se a ki taraf electrostatic field E aur force qE banti hai. Equilibrium mein dono barabar:
qE = qvB, yani E = vB ... (10.17)
Electric intensity potential gradient ka manfi hai:
E = -ΔV/L ... (10.18)
ΔV = -LE = -(LvB)
ε = ΔV = -LvB ... (10.19)
Is ki magnitude vBL hai. Agar v aur B ka angle θ ho:
ε = -vBL sin θ ... (10.20)

Current: Positive charges abcda ke raaste behte hain, is liye current anticlockwise hai. Oopar se charge kam hone par electric field kam hota hai magar magnetic force wahi rehti hai; ghair mutawazan magnetic force a tak pohanchne wale charges ko wapas b tak le jati hai, is liye current jaari rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Consider an experiment as shown in Fig. 10.13.

blocks.prompt:
12 A 75 cm rod moves at 4.0 m s⁻¹ in a uniform magnetic field of 0.35 T. Find (i) the electric field set up inside the rod and (ii) the motional emf, when it moves at right angles to the field (iii) the emf when its velocity makes 30° with the field. (3 marks)
(75 cm ki rod 0.35 T ke uniform magnetic field mein 4.0 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. Nikalein: (i) rod ke andar banne wala electric field aur (ii) motional emf, jab woh field par amoodi chale (iii) emf jab us ki velocity field se 30° par ho.)
blocks.explanation: Equilibrium mein E = vB; emf ki magnitude vBL, aur θ angle par vBL sin θ.

book_ref.quote: The motional emf ε will be equal to the potential difference

blocks.prompt:
13 Starting from the motional emf ε = -vBL, derive the relation between induced emf and the rate of change of magnetic flux. Extend it to a coil of N loops, state Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction and explain the minus sign. (5 marks)
(Motional emf ε = -vBL se shuru kar ke induced emf aur magnetic flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah ka talluq derive karein. Isay N loops wali coil tak barhayein, Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka qanoon bayan karein aur manfi nishan ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Derivation: Fig. 10.14 ke tajrube mein rod chhote waqt Δt mein position 1 se position 2 tak jati hai. Tay kiya faasla x₂ - x₁ = Δx. Chunke rod mustaqil velocity se chalti hai,
v = Δx/Δt ... (10.21)
Isay Eq. (10.19) mein rakhne se:
ε = -vBL = -(Δx/Δt)BL ... (10.22)
Rod ke Δx chalne se loop ka area ΔA = ΔxL barhta hai, is liye flux Δϕ = (ΔA)B = (ΔxL)B barhta hai. Lehaza
ε = -Δϕ/Δt ... (10.23)
Aik loop ka flux badle to us ki tabdeeli ki sharah ka manfi loop ki induced emf ke barabar hai.

N loops ki coil: Emf N guna ho jati hai:
ε = -N Δϕ/Δt ... (10.24)
Agarche yeh motional emf se nikla, magar yeh aam tor par durust hai.

Faraday ka qanoon: N loops wali conducting coil mein average induced emf, coil se guzarne wale magnetic flux ki waqt ke saath tabdeeli ki sharah ke manfi ke barabar hai.

Manfi nishan: Yeh batata hai ke induced emf ki simt aisi hai ke woh flux ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare.

book_ref.quote: The motional emf as well as other induced emfs can be described in terms of magnetic flux.

blocks.prompt:
14 A coil of 80 turns, each of area 0.020 m², is held perpendicular to a magnetic field. The field increases uniformly from 0.10 T to 0.50 T in 0.040 s. Find (i) the change in flux through each turn (ii) the magnitude of the average induced emf (iii) the emf if the same change took 0.080 s. (3 marks)
(80 turns wali coil, har turn ka area 0.020 m², magnetic field par amoodi hai. Field 0.040 s mein yaksaan tor par 0.10 T se 0.50 T ho jata hai. Nikalein: (i) har turn ke flux mein tabdeeli (ii) average induced emf ki magnitude (iii) emf agar yahi tabdeeli 0.080 s mein ho.)
blocks.explanation: Aik turn ke liye Δϕ = (ΔB)A nikalein, phir Faraday ka qanoon ε = NΔϕ/Δt lagayein.

book_ref.quote: This conclusion was first arrived at by Faraday

blocks.prompt:
15 State Lenz's law. Apply it to find the polarity of a coil when a bar magnet is pushed towards it and pulled away. Show that Lenz's law is a manifestation of the law of conservation of energy, using the moving rod on rails. (5 marks)
(Lenz ka qanoon bayan karein. Bar magnet ko coil ki taraf dhakelne aur door kheenchne par coil ki polarity maloom karne ke liye isay lagayein. Rails par chalti rod ki madad se dikhayein ke Lenz ka qanoon conservation of energy ke qanoon ka izhar hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Pas-e-manzar: ε = -N ΔΦ/Δt mein manfi nishan induced emf ki simt se mutalliq hai. Heinrich Lenz (1834) ne dekha ke induced emf ki polarity hamesha aisa induced current paida karti hai jo us magnetic field ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare jis ne emf paida ki.

Lenz ka qanoon: Induced current ki simt hamesha aisi hoti hai ke woh us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare jis ne current paida kiya.
Yeh induced currents par, yani band loops par lagta hai; khule loop ko band farz kar ke current ki simt aur us se emf ki simt nikalte hain.

Magnet aur coil (Fig. 10.15): Current wali coil bar magnet ki tarah hai, aik rukh north aur doosra south. Magnet ka north pole coil ki taraf dhakelne par dhakkay ki mukhalifat ke liye qareebi rukh north pole banta hai aur do north poles aik doosre ko dhakelte hain; right-hand rule se magnet ki taraf se current anticlockwise hai. Magnet door kheenchne par qareebi rukh south pole ban kar kheenchne ki mukhalifat karta hai.

Conservation of energy (Fig. 10.16): Rod daayen chalne par induced current anticlockwise behta hai. Field mein current wali rod par F_m = ILB sin 90° lagti hai jo right-hand rule se v ke ulat hai aur rod ko rokti hai. v mustaqil rakhne ke liye F_m ke barabar aur ulat bahar ki force lagani parti hai; yahi induced current ke liye energy deti hai.
Agar current clockwise hota to F_m, v ki taraf hoti aur rod tez hoti. Is se current aur force barhte aur rod mazeed tez hoti: be-wajah barhti kinetic energy. Yeh conservation of energy ke khilaf hai, is liye Lenz ka qanoon iski ijazat nahi deta.

book_ref.quote: To determine the direction, we use a principle based on the discovery

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Lenz ke qanoon ka khulasa: induced current hamesha 'mukhalifat' karta hai. Magnet paas aaye to coil use dhakelti hai, door jaye to kheenchti hai. Isi liye humein kaam karna parta hai aur yahi kaam electrical energy banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
16 A 50 cm rod slides at a constant 3.0 m s⁻¹ along rails, at right angles to a uniform field of 0.40 T. The induced current in the closed loop is 2.0 A. Find (i) the induced emf (ii) the magnetic force F_m on the rod (iii) the external force needed to keep the rod moving at constant velocity. (3 marks)
(50 cm ki rod rails par mustaqil 3.0 m s⁻¹ se 0.40 T ke uniform field par amoodi phisal rahi hai. Band loop mein induced current 2.0 A hai. Nikalein: (i) induced emf (ii) rod par magnetic force F_m (iii) rod ko mustaqil velocity se chalane ke liye bahar ki force.)
blocks.explanation: ε = vBL lagayein; phir F_m = ILB sin 90°, jo v ki mukhalif hai; bahar ki force F_m ke barabar aur v ki simt mein honi chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Magnetic flux density = B = 0.25 T = 0.25 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹

steps: (iii) Bahar ki force = 0.40 N, v ki simt mein
blocks.final_answer: (i) 0.60 V (ii) 0.40 N, v ke ulat (iii) 0.40 N, v ki simt mein

blocks.prompt:
17 Using Faraday's law ε = -N Δϕ/Δt, describe the factors on which the magnitude of the induced emf depends. Show how each factor appears in the law, and explain how an emf can be induced by changing the area of a loop in a constant field. (5 marks)
(Faraday ke qanoon ε = -N Δϕ/Δt ki madad se un awamil ko bayan karein jin par induced emf ki magnitude munhasir hai. Dikhayein ke har factor qanoon mein kaise aata hai, aur mustaqil field mein loop ka area badal kar emf kaise induce hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Faraday ka qanoon: ε = -N Δϕ/Δt (Eq. 10.24). Induced emf ki magnitude in par munhasir hai:

1. Magnetic flux badalne ki sharah: Faraday ke qanoon se flux jitna tez badle emf utni zyada; ε, Δϕ/Δt ke tanasub mein hai. Wohi flux kam waqt mein badle to emf zyada.

2. Coil ke turns: Emf N ke tanasub mein hai. N loops ki coil aik loop se N guna emf deti hai; zyada turns, zyada emf.

3. Relative speed: Field mein coil (ya conductor) ki speed emf par asar karti hai. Tez speed flux badalne ki sharah aur emf barhati hai. Rod ke liye ε = vBL, yani ε, v ke tanasub mein.

Area badalna: Flux ϕ = BA cos θ hai. Agar B mustaqil aur loop par amoodi ho (θ = 0) magar area badle to Δϕ/Δt = B(ΔA/Δt). Tab
ε = N B ΔA/Δt
maslan field mein sukarta loop (Example 10.7) emf deta hai halanke B nahi badalta.

book_ref.quote: Faraday's law suggests that faster changes in magnetic flux result in greater induced emf.

blocks.prompt:
18 A coil of 20 turns lies perpendicular to a uniform field of 0.50 T. The area of each turn increases at a constant rate of 0.030 m² s⁻¹. Find the induced emf (i) for this coil (ii) for a 40-turn coil under the same conditions (iii) for the 40-turn coil if the area increases twice as fast. (3 marks)
(20 turns wali coil 0.50 T ke uniform field par amoodi hai. Har turn ka area 0.030 m² s⁻¹ ki mustaqil sharah se barhta hai. Induced emf nikalein (i) is coil ke liye (ii) inhi halaat mein 40 turns wali coil ke liye (iii) 40 turns wali coil ke liye agar area do guna tezi se barhe.)
blocks.explanation: ε = NB(ΔA/Δt) lagayein; phir dekhein ke N aur sharah double karne se ε kaise badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: According to Faraday's law, induced emf is also proportional to the number of turns

steps: (ii) N = 40: ε = 40 × 0.50 × 0.030 = 0.60 V (double turns, double emf)
(iii) ΔA/Δt = 0.060 m² s⁻¹: ε = 40 × 0.50 × 0.060 = 1.2 V (tez tabdeeli, zyada emf)

blocks.prompt:
19 What is a seismometer? Describe its construction and explain how it uses electromagnetic induction to record an earthquake. What information does it give, and how is it installed? (5 marks)
(Seismometer kya hai? Is ki banawat bayan karein aur wazahat karein ke yeh zalzale ko record karne ke liye electromagnetic induction kaise istemal karta hai. Yeh kya maloomat deta hai aur kaise lagaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Seismometer aisa aala hai jo zameen ke neeche chattanon ki harkat ya zalzalon, aatish fishan aur dhamakon ki vibrations ko mehsoos karta hai. Yeh electromagnetic induction se zameen ki harkat ko electrical signals mein badal kar zalzale ka pata lagata hai.

Banawat (Fig. 10.19): Zameen se jure frame se aik wazan spring ke zariye latka hota hai. Wazan aik magnet se jura hai jo taar ki coil ke andar harkat karta hai.

Kaam: Zalzale mein zameen (aur frame) hilti hai magar wazan inertia ki wajah se apni jagah rehta hai. Is se magnet aur coil mein relative harkat hoti hai. Faraday ke qanoon se coil ka badalta flux emf induce karta hai jo induced current chalati hai. Induced current zameen ki harkat ki velocity ke tanasub mein hai.

Maloomat: Signals amplify aur record hote hain aur zalzale ki waves ka amplitude, frequency aur duration dete hain. In ke tajziye se location, magnitude aur depth maloom hoti hai. Seismic waves ki do bari qismein P-waves (primary, longitudinal) aur S-waves (secondary, transverse) hain.

Lagana: Seismometer aam tor par zameen mein 50-1000 m gehrai par vault naami hifazati dabbe mein dabaya jata hai; yeh taqreeban 1 m chaura aur 2 m gehra cylindrical steel tank hai jis ke neeche concrete pad hota hai (Fig. 10.20).

book_ref.quote: Typically, a seismometer includes a weight suspended by a spring.

blocks.prompt:
20 In a seismometer, the magnet moves relative to a coil of 400 turns and changes the flux through each turn by 2.0 × 10⁻⁵ Wb in 0.010 s. Find (i) the average induced emf (ii) the emf if a stronger tremor moves the ground twice as fast, so the same flux change takes 0.0050 s. (3 marks)
(Seismometer mein magnet 400 turns wali coil ke lehaaz se harkat kar ke har turn ka flux 0.010 s mein 2.0 × 10⁻⁵ Wb badalta hai. Nikalein: (i) average induced emf (ii) emf agar tez jhatka zameen ko do guna tezi se hilaye aur yahi flux tabdeeli 0.0050 s mein ho.)
blocks.explanation: Faraday ka qanoon ε = NΔϕ/Δt lagayein; zameen ki tez harkat ka matlab kam Δt aur zyada emf.

book_ref.quote: This setup works according to Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction

steps: Zameen do guna tez hile to emf (aur induced current) bhi double.
